newPlatforms.name: KEXP Global Digital Music Submission Email Route
newPlatforms.country: United States / Seattle, Washington / global listener-powered independent public radio
newPlatforms.feeAmount: No music-submission fee is stated. KEXP explicitly says artists cannot pay the station for airplay.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: KEXP accepts singles, albums and EPs through the publicly listed Music Department mailbox md@kexp.org. The email must include both a streaming link and a WAV download link, with no attachments, plus artist identity and pronouns, release title, label where applicable, phonetic spellings where needed, focus tracks, release dates, clean edits for FCC-restricted content, lyrics, credits, a bio or one-sheet and relevant Pacific Northwest or Bay Area shows. A human must select a rights-cleared MarcsMusic release, review content and metadata, prepare the required links and supporting information, and send manually.
newPlatforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-14 from KEXP's official Contact, Submission Guidelines, Getting Airplay, homepage and Shows pages. The official Contact and Submission Guidelines pages publish md@kexp.org specifically for rotation consideration and state that the mailbox is the preferred submission route. KEXP requires streaming and WAV download links and prohibits attachments and unsolicited physical submissions. Its FAQ confirms that rotation can include singles as well as albums and EPs and explicitly rejects pay-for-play. Current operation was confirmed through live-stream controls, July 2026 events and active programming. Relevant KEXP programming includes electronic, world, dub, reggae, ambient, downtempo, global and experimental music, including Positive Vibrations, Wo' Pop, Pacific Notions, Mechanical Breakdown and variety programming. Email verification was limited to first-party plaintext publication, valid syntax, stated Music Department purpose and kexp.org domain alignment. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed. No email, attachment, stream, download, metadata, personal information, rights declaration, payment, CAPTCHA, login or anti-bot control was used.

newPlatforms.name: WXPN 88.5 Digital EPK Music Submission Route
newPlatforms.country: United States / Philadelphia, Pennsylvania / nonprofit public radio and music-discovery service
newPlatforms.feeAmount: No fee or mandatory payment is stated for the official WXPN airplay-submission route.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: WXPN's official Contact page authorizes unsolicited airplay submissions by email to the Music Director and requires an EPK containing a link to digitally download the music. The destination is presented through a first-party Email Music Director action but was not exposed in plaintext in the passive page representation, so it was not decoded or guessed. The separate Local Show route requires local relevance and was not queued for MarcsMusic. A human must reopen the official page, use only the current Music Director action, confirm international and catalogue fit, prepare a concise EPK and reliable download link, and send manually.
newPlatforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-14 from WXPN's official Contact page, homepage and Program Guide. The Contact page explicitly includes questions and music submissions and instructs artists seeking airplay to email an EPK with a digital music-download link to the Music Director. WXPN warns that it cannot confirm receipt or airplay for unsolicited submissions. The separate Local Show route requests a WAV or high-quality MP3, short bio and upcoming show information and was excluded because it is a distinct locally focused opportunity. The main airplay route does not state a fee, payment, login or CAPTCHA requirement, but the exact email destination was not surfaced in passive plaintext and was not decoded or guessed. Current operation was confirmed through an active 2026 homepage, current music-news and broadcast content, and a populated guide featuring curated music, emerging artists, World Cafe and dance programming. No email, EPK, music link, audio, biography, metadata, personal information, payment, CAPTCHA, authentication or anti-bot control was used, and no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.
